# PTERI Wallet

> PTERI Wallet is a Litecoin wallet from KAKR Labs that brings payments, sign-in, added verification, and supported AI-agent approval experiences into one wallet. Availability and features depend on the app release and platform, so check each page and store listing before relying on a feature.

This site covers choosing a platform, setting up or restoring a wallet, security and recovery guidance, and compatibility details.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://pteri.kakr.org/): Overview of PTERI Wallet and the ways to get it (iPhone and iPad, Android, web).
- [Get Started](https://pteri.kakr.org/get-started): Choose a create, restore, or return path and review the platform and recovery checks before you begin.
- [Security & Recovery](https://pteri.kakr.org/security): Everyday wallet access, recovery preparation, and what to review before approving a transfer or application request.
- [Compatibility](https://pteri.kakr.org/compatibility): Platform choices and the formats, address types, and operations to check before creating or restoring a wallet.
- [Help](https://pteri.kakr.org/help): Guidance on setup, restoration, saved-wallet access, balances, transfers, MWEB, and safe support requests.
